messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "once per day at same time of day"
set: ["once per day at same time of day", "take at same time each day", "take at same time every day", "once per day", "same day", "take at around the same time each day", "taken at approximately the same time each day", "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day", "take with food at the same time each day", "usually taken once per day", "extended-release capsules are taken once daily at about the same time each day", "administer once weekly on the same day each week at any time of the day with or without meals", "twice per day", "no fixed time of day", "can be taken at any time of day", "injected under the skin once per week at any time of the day with or without food"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
